conviction_note: Three small, partly offsetting findings on an unsourced bar: the one-time Costco load in Q4 is being cleared at .97 prices so Q1 revenue likely steps down sequentially against a year-ago quarter that itself held Costco's initial load (-1.2), against a disclosed $0.91m IEEPA refund booked in FY27 that inflates Q1 GAAP EPS (+0.5) and $2.8m of XCOR II orders shipping in Q2 that the call will lean on (+0.6); impact_sum -0.1, and the scaled number is (2*48/100-1)*8 = -0.32. The two measurements agree on sign and near-zero size; the gap to the name's 5-11% realised moves is the honest uncertainty about sign, carried in p_up rather than in the findings.
bar: unsourced. Two estimates per the baseline, but no free source shows them (chartmill 403, Zacks bot wall, Investing.com paywalled, stockscan blank). The company gives no quarterly or annual guidance ('variability in timing of large retail orders', https://quartr.com/events/axil-brands-inc-axil-q4-2026_FMdaiQdN). Reference points used instead: year-ago Q1 FY26 net sales $6.9m, EPS $0.04 (https://goaxil.com/blogs/press-releases/axil-brands-inc-reports-first-quarter-fiscal-year-2026-financial-results) and Q4 FY26 $8.6m (https://goaxil.com/blogs/press-releases/axil-brands-inc-reports-fiscal-2026-and-fourth-quarter-financial-results). Every finding is capped small for this reason.
positioning_check: Short interest 6,016 shares on 2026-09-15 settlement, 0.1% of shares outstanding, 1.0 days to cover (https://equibles.com/stocks/axil/shortinterest); not crowded, so no squeeze adjustment to the negative. No options market (baseline), so no skew. Insiders: CEO Toghraie group beneficially owns 46.9% incl. voting agreement over Vasquez's 1.275m shares expiring 2026-10-17 (13D/A 2026-08-20, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1718500/000152013826000368/xslSCHEDULE_13D_X02/primary_doc.xml). Tape: spot 6.13, 20d -0.8%, 5d -2.2%, 29% off the 52w high, ~13k shares/day (~$80k).

findings.finding: Q4 FY26's record $8.6m included a one-time big-box load in May (10-K: AR up to $4.75m on 'material orders from a big box retail chain' in the final month), and the Costco item first seen 2026-05-11, AXIL MX Pro II SE earmuffs + X30i bundle (item 2049073), is now being cleared at corporate .97 markdowns ($39.97-$59.97 from $99.99 over the last 60 days, in stock at 168 of 599 warehouses), so Q1 FY27 (Jun-Aug) had no Costco reorder, a sequential step-down from Q4 and a hard y/y comp against Q1 FY26's own initial Costco XCOR SE load ($6.9m).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Revenue is the line this name trades on: Q2 FY26 (2026-01-08) +15.56% and Q4 FY26 (2026-08-18) -11.28% despite +48.9% revenue and $0.18 EPS, i.e. the record lumpy-load quarter was sold; Q1 FY26 +17% revenue bought +4.25% (baseline).
findings.source_date: 2026-10-06 (page as fetched; first sighting 2026-05-11, price range over the trailing 60 days)
findings.why_not_priced: No analyst or wire item mentions the Costco clearance; the market's only public signals are the Aug 18 record quarter and the Aug 26 XCOR II order release. If the step-down were priced the stock would have kept falling after the -11% instead of holding ~$6.1-6.2 flat for 20 sessions with 0.1% short interest. Partly priced: the -11% on Aug 18 suggests some holders already read Q4 as a load quarter.
findings.independence: 10-K FY2026 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1718500/000152013826000360/axil-20260531_10k.htm) documents the May big-box order and receivables spike; .97 = corporate clearance convention (https://chowhound.com/stories/the-importance-of-97-on-costco-price-tags). Net of the rest: Walmart was expanded to ~1,250 stores (Apr 29), MCX full line in July and Sportsman's ~70 stores, footprint ~1,800 -> ~6,000 stores; those can carry y/y growth, which is why this is sized small. Costco being the May big-box customer is an inference; the 10-K does not name it.

findings.finding: The ~$910k IEEPA duty refund (incl. interest) received after 2026-05-31 is recognised in FY2027, i.e. in Q1 FY27, worth roughly $0.11 per diluted share (FY26 diluted EPS $0.33 on $2.7m implies ~8.2m diluted shares) against a year-ago Q1 EPS of $0.04, so headline GAAP EPS should print several times last year's.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior refund quarter for this name; across the repo's tariff-refund names the refund landed and the stock moved with guidance direction, not the refund. This company does not guide.
findings.why_not_priced: Disclosed on Aug 18, so it is public; what may not be priced is the headline: a thinly traded, 47%-insider-held name with two estimates whose EPS headline (The Fly-style 'Q1 EPS Xc vs 4c') will look like a step change. If it were fully priced the Aug 18 reaction would not have been -11%. Sized as a fraction of the same dollars as operating profit because it has no path to a guide.
findings.independence: 10-K subsequent-event text confirms the receipt and FY27 recognition (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1718500/000152013826000360/axil-20260531_10k.htm); same fact, one finding.

findings.finding: XCOR II, the flagship earbud successor, carried initial orders above $2.8m 'expected to ship in September' (Q2 FY27), about a third of a record quarter's revenue from one SKU's sell-in, which the 5pm call will use to frame Q2; the same transition likely depressed Q1 XCOR reorders (absorbed in the first finding, not counted twice).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No formal guide ever given; Q2 FY26's +15.56% came with retail-expansion commentary. The stock touched $7.00 around 2026-08-31 after the Aug 26 release and faded to $6.13.
findings.why_not_priced: The order figure is public but the stock gave back the post-release pop, so the market is not paying for Q2; any reorder or sell-through colour on the call would be new. If priced, the stock would sit near the $7 level it touched after the release.
findings.independence: Q4 call summary: 'major product launch (XCOR 2.0) is scheduled for September' (https://quartr.com/events/axil-brands-inc-axil-q4-2026_FMdaiQdN); company-sourced both times.

outside_window.finding: Voting agreement giving the CEO group voting control over Vasquez's 1,275,000 shares (18.7%) expires 2026-10-17; potential overhang if Vasquez becomes a free seller in a ~$80k/day tape.

Rule 2 (one-off with no path to a guide): tariff-refund finding cut from +0.8 to +0.5.
Rule 6 cap and rule 1 (company does not guide, beats have been sold): XCOR II guidance finding cut from +0.8 to +0.6.
